tools.name: courtreserve_list_members
tools.description: List the club's members (name, email, phone, membership type and status, start/end/next payment dates, family id). Filter by member id, family, exact email, phone or the created (at most 30 days) / created-or-updated (at most 31 days) time. Paged: pass next_page back as page. PIN codes and SSO links

tools.name: courtreserve_get_member_reservations
tools.description: A member's upcoming (or dated) court bookings and event registrations: type, start/end, courts, event name and players. For a family member the reply covers the whole family. Give the member id or your own external id. Needs the Member role (Read). GET /api/v1/member/reservations.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_families
tools.description: List family accounts (family id, name, number, members and membership). Needs the Family role (Read). GET /api/v1/family/get.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_membership_types
tools.description: The club's membership types (id, name, price, billing and status). Use the ids to filter the membership report. Needs the MembershipType role (Read). GET /api/v1/membershiptype/get.

tools.name: courtreserve_membership_report
tools.description: The Membership report: one row per member or family membership with status, billing cadence, start/end, next payment and cancellation history. Filter by type, assignment (family or individual) and the start, end, next-payment or cancellation dates. Paged. Needs the Membership Report role (Read). GET

tools.name: courtreserve_list_courts
tools.description: The club's courts: id, label, court type and order. Use the ids in court utilization and court blocks. Needs the Reservation role (Read). GET /api/v1/reservation/courts.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_reservation_types
tools.description: The club's reservation types (court booking, lesson, court block and so on) with ids. Needs the Reservation role (Read). GET /api/v1/reservation/reservationtypes.

tools.name: courtreserve_get_court_availability
tools.description: Court availability: each court's operating hours and the time slots already booked, for one date or a date range of at most 31 days (time zone of the club in the reply). Needs the Reservation role (Read). GET /api/v1/reservation/availability.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_reservations
tools.description: Active court reservations for a reservation period (the dates played) or a created/updated period, at most 31 days each: type, courts, start/end, players with contact details and what they owe/paid. Give at least one period. PIN codes are not returned. Needs the ReservationReport role (Read). GET /a

tools.name: courtreserve_list_cancelled_reservations
tools.description: Cancelled court reservations by the date they were cancelled or by the reservation period, at most 31 days each. Give at least one period. Needs the ReservationReport role (Read). GET /api/v1/reservationreport/listcancelled.

tools.name: courtreserve_whos_here
tools.description: Who is booked in a time window (for example today): member reservations and event registrations with the member, court and time, optionally including or only cancelled ones. The window can be at most 31 days. Needs the ReservationReport role (Read). GET /api/v1/reservationreport/whoisheretoday.

tools.name: courtreserve_court_utilization
tools.description: Court utilization report (booked vs available time per time slot) for a period of at most 7 days, optionally for chosen courts, court types, event types, event tags or reservation types. Needs the ReservationReport role (Read). GET /api/v1/reservationreport/courtutilization.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_event_categories
tools.description: Event categories (clinics, round robins, tournaments, open play...) with ids. Needs the EventCalendar role (Read). GET /api/v1/eventcalendar/categories.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_events
tools.description: Events on the club calendar between two dates: name, category, start/end, courts, instructors, capacity, registered and waitlist counts, price and rating limits. SSO links are not returned. Needs the EventCalendar role (Read). GET /api/v1/eventcalendar/eventlist.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_event_registrations
tools.description: Active registrations for events, clinics and lessons with the member, event and what was paid. Give an event period or a registration period, at most 31 days each. Needs the EventRegistrationReport role (Read). GET /api/v1/eventregistrationreport/listactive.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_event_waitlist
tools.description: People on event waitlists. Give an event period or a registration period, at most 31 days each. Needs the EventRegistrationReport role (Read). GET /api/v1/eventregistrationreport/listwaitlist.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_cancelled_event_registrations
tools.description: Cancelled event registrations by cancellation date or by event date, at most 31 days each. Give at least one period. Needs the EventRegistrationReport role (Read). GET /api/v1/eventregistrationreport/listcancelled.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_checkins
tools.description: Check-in report: who checked in to court bookings and events, by check-in period or reservation period (at most 31 days each). Give at least one period. Role: the key's access to attendance data. GET /api/v1/attendancereport/checkin.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_transactions
tools.description: Transactions (fees, membership fees, payments, refunds...) by transaction date or reservation date: id, type, date, subtotal, tax, total, unpaid amount, payment type, category and the member's name, email and phone. Filter by type, paid/unpaid and payment type. Give at least one period. Needs the Tr

tools.name: courtreserve_sales_summary
tools.description: Detailed sales summary for a payment period of at most 31 days: paid fees plus refunds by category and payment type. Needs the Transactions role (Read). GET /api/v1/transactions/salessummarydetailed.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_promo_codes
tools.description: The club's promo codes: code, name, type, value, dates, limits and what they apply to. Needs the PromoCodes role (Read). GET /api/v1/promocode/get.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_leagues
tools.description: The club's leagues, with their sessions (id and name) when include_sessions is true (default). Paged. Needs the League role (Read). GET /api/v1/league/get.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_league_sessions
tools.description: League sessions, for one league or one session, optionally with their game days and registered players. Paged. Needs the League role (Read). GET /api/v1/league/sessions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: courtreserve_list_members, courtreserve_list_transactions · Private data: courtreserve_list_reservations · Public sink: courtreserve_list_members, courtreserve_list_transactions.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: courtreserve_list_members, courtreserve_list_transactions · Private data: courtreserve_list_reservations · Public sink: courtreserve_list_members, courtreserve_list_transactions

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
